The more I learn of Scotland (and England too ) , I understand how my  centuries old families were able to settle  the shore and lowlands of Virginia by my English side dating back to Jamestown, 1609. They pushed then into the mountains of Virginia and what became West Virginia as quickly as they could.My Scottish side sailed into Philadelphia in the first decade of the 1700s ( I wonder what was happening in that decade in Scotland , and England ?!) and pushed into the mountains of central and western Pennsylvania as quickly as they could.
Neither side would marry each other or anyone  not of English or Scottish descent respectively , even though they lived and worked and fought for America and settled next to one another.They didn't start to marry each other until after WWI.This is very unusual for America , but there were always a lot of " their own kind " around to marry ! My great-grandfathers on both sides said that they were taught that the mountains will always keep you free. The expression is similar to the State Motto of West Virginia too.The Appalachian Chain of mountains is beautiful and wild and dangerous. Both sides of my family are from The Alleghenies.The Appalachian Chain is extremely old too and once were as high as the Alps too.The spirit of America's settlers comes from the spirit of Scotland and the land.( And I must add England too ! )


My families and I have visited both England and Scotland in the middle and late 20th Century and earlier in this Century and have come away with in  the most awe of Scotland.The pull of the mountains and sea is incredible and breathtaking and seems like home too .
Thank you for this very beautiful and very interesting video !
New Subscriber -- and I hope you have more videos and are making more in the future .
